title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
title_zh: LEASH：面向计算机使用智能体的不确定性感知式弱-强升级与监督机制

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks, where running a frontier model at every step is expensive and a small open-weight model alone often fails. Weak-to-strong escalation offers a middle ground where a weak agent acts by default and hands control to a strong one only when needed. The core challenge is deciding when to escalate, which requires an uncertainty signal cheap enough to check at every step. However, even after handoff, the strong agent can still get lost, but a black-box API that the strong agent is usually served exposes no internals to monitor. To this end, we propose LEASH , a training-free framework that unleashes the strong agent only when the weak agent’s latent uncertainty signals it is needed, and keeps it on a leash afterward. LEASH has three layers: (1) initial task uncertainty for early routing, (2) step-level uncertainty for runtime escalation, and, after handoff, (3) a shadow observer for continued oversight of the strong black-box agent. Here, we use latent uncertainty as a fuel for all three layers. Specifically, we compare the weak model’s hidden states with those from its past successful and failed trajectories, and a state that looks more like the failures signals higher uncertainty. During weak-agent execution, our uncertainty estimator reuses activations already produced during action generation, so it needs no extra forward pass or dedicated monitor training. Experiments on OSWorld across four contemporary model backbones show that LEASH consistently improves over standalone weak agents and outperforms random escalation by 6.55–11.94 points at matched escalation rates. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, LEASH achieves 73.66% task success at $0.4117 per task, matching always-on Claude Opus 5 (72.90%) while reducing inference cost by 19.2%.

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) automate tasks of graphical interfaces by translating natural-language instructions and visual observations into executable actions ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) , and are increasingly deployed for complex, long-horizon automation tasks that can take more than an hour on average ( Abhyankar et al., 2026 ) . While frontier proprietary models have been shown to achieve impressive performance leaps ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026a ) , running every single task spanning hundreds of steps with these models raises cost concerns, whereas a light open-weight model alone performs poorly on even much simpler tasks ( Xie et al., 2024 ) . This creates a fundamental trade-off between accuracy and cost efficiency, motivating weak-to-strong escalation (W2SE), in which a weak agent serves as the primary executor and hands control to a strong agent only when needed ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Lei and Huang, 2026 ) . W2SE raises two important questions: (1) When should the weak agent escalate, and (2) who oversees the strong agent after handing over?

paragraphs.en: Existing work on W2SE primarily focuses on the first question, estimating the weak agent’s failure risk to decide when escalation is needed. Some of them adopt another monitoring agent to verify each step ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Yi et al., 2026 ) , others train an extra monitoring module on the collection of annotated trajectories ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Lei and Huang, 2026 ) . However, the former inevitably adds nontrivial cost to run another heavy agent step-by-step, whereas the latter creates another phase of data annotation and training, hindering direct adoption in real-world applications under varying deployment constraints. While training-free uncertainty estimation-based approaches might avoid the aforementioned bottlenecks ( Oh et al., 2026b ) , prior works still rely on external knowledge base ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , another reference model ( Oh et al., 2026a ) , or multiple sampling for each step ( Wang et al., 2026 ) quickly becomes infeasible or impractical in long-horizon tasks in the wild.
paragraphs.zh: 关于 W2SE 的现有研究主要关注第一个问题，即估算弱智能体的失败风险，以决定何时需要升级处理。 其中一些方法采用另一个监控智能体来验证每一步（Wang et al., 2024；Yi et al., 2026），另一些方法则在已标注轨迹的集合上训练一个额外的监控模块（Wei et al., 2026；Lei and Huang, 2026）。 然而，前者不可避免地需要运行另一个重型智能体来逐步执行，从而产生显著的成本；而后者则引入了数据标注和训练的额外阶段，在部署条件多变的实际应用中阻碍了直接采用。 尽管无需训练的不确定性估计方法可能避免了上述瓶颈（Oh et al., 2026b），但先前的研究仍然依赖外部知识库（Liu et al., 2026）、另一个参考模型（Oh et al., 2026a）或每一步进行多次采样（Wang et al., 2026），这些方法在真实世界中的长时程任务中很快就会变得不可行或不切实际。

paragraphs.en: Besides, escalation alone does not eliminate execution uncertainty, resulting in the second important question in W2SE which is commonly overlooked. That is, even after a stronger agent takes control, subsequent actions may deviate from the intended task or fail to achieve the desired outcome. However, monitoring a black-box strong agent is challenging because its internal states are inaccessible and verbalized confidence can be unreliable on evolving context of long-horizon task ( Han et al., 2024 ; Kirchhof et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 此外，仅靠升级智能体本身并不能消除执行过程中的不确定性，这引出了 W2SE 中第二个常被忽视的重要问题。 也就是说，即使由更强大的智能体接管控制，后续行动仍可能偏离原定任务，或无法达成预期结果。 然而，监控一个黑箱式的强大智能体极具挑战性，因为其内部状态不可访问，且其表述出的置信度在长期任务的动态语境中可能并不可靠（Han et al., 2024；Kirchhof et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: To answer both questions, we formulate W2SE as a budget-constrained sequential stopping problem, and use the weak agent’s failure risk as a proxy for the expected benefit of escalation. We then propose L atent uncertainty for E scalation A nd SH adow oversight ( LEASH ), a training-free framework driven by the uncertainty signal in the weak agent’s hidden states. First, we record its hidden states of prompt and action tokens on a small set of held-out tasks and label them with task-level and subgoal-level outcomes to construct a representation bank. This representation bank then serves as a semantic anchor to score the newly faced prompts and actions during test-time by measuring, under a Mahalanobis metric in latent space, how much closer each one lies to past failures than to past successes. LEASH puts this signal on two jobs (Figure 2 ): For escalation , an initial gate scores uncertainty from the task prompt query, while a runtime gate monitors subsequent execution trace. For oversight , after the weak model hands the control to the strong agent, it switches its role from actor to observer that monitors the strong agent’s trajectory every three steps; when its uncertainty is high, the pending action is rolled back and re-decided once with higher reasoning effort. Importantly, our uncertainty-driven W2SE formulation draws on an easily accessible resource, the weak agent’s own past experience ( Silver and Sutton, 2025 ) , removing reliance on an external dataset or additional training without hosting another expensive agent during runtime, while offering extensibility for recursive self-improvement ( Schmidhuber, 2007 ; Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了解答这两个问题，我们将 W2SE 构建为一个受预算限制的序列停止问题，并利用弱智能体的失败风险作为升级决策预期收益的代理指标。 接着，我们提出了“潜在不确定性用于升级与监督”（LEASH）框架，这是一个无需训练的模型，其运行由弱智能体隐藏状态中的不确定性信号驱动。 首先，我们在少量预留任务上记录其提示词和行动令牌的隐藏状态，并用任务层级和子目标层级的结果进行标注，从而构建一个表示库。 该表示库随后充当语义锚点，在测试阶段通过测量新遇到的提示词和行动在潜在空间中与历史失败案例相比相对于历史成功案例的接近程度（基于马哈拉诺比斯度量），来对其评分。 LEASH 将这一信号用于两项任务（图 2）：对于升级决策，初始门控机制根据任务提示词查询评估不确定性，而运行时门控机制则监控后续的执行轨迹。 对于监督环节，在弱模型将控制权移交给强智能体后，它会从执行者转变为观察者，每三步监控一次强智能体的运行轨迹；当其不确定性较高时，待执行的动作将被回滚，并通过更深入的推理重新决策一次。 重要的是，我们基于不确定性的 W2SE 构建方法利用了一个易于获取的资源——弱智能体自身的过往经验（Silver and Sutton, 2025），从而无需依赖外部数据集或额外训练，也无需在运行时部署另一个昂贵的智能体，同时支持递归式自我改进的扩展性（Schmidhuber, 2007；Zelikman et al., 2022；Madaan et al., 2023；Shinn et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2023）。

sents.en: For oversight , after the weak model hands the control to the strong agent, it switches its role from actor to observer that monitors the strong agent’s trajectory every three steps; when its uncertainty is high, the pending action is rolled back and re-decided once with higher reasoning effort.
sents.zh: 对于监督环节，在弱模型将控制权移交给强智能体后，它会从执行者转变为观察者，每三步监控一次强智能体的运行轨迹；当其不确定性较高时，待执行的动作将被回滚，并通过更深入的推理重新决策一次。

sents.en: Importantly, our uncertainty-driven W2SE formulation draws on an easily accessible resource, the weak agent’s own past experience ( Silver and Sutton, 2025 ) , removing reliance on an external dataset or additional training without hosting another expensive agent during runtime, while offering extensibility for recursive self-improvement ( Schmidhuber, 2007 ; Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 重要的是，我们基于不确定性的 W2SE 构建方法利用了一个易于获取的资源——弱智能体自身的过往经验（Silver and Sutton, 2025），从而无需依赖外部数据集或额外训练，也无需在运行时部署另一个昂贵的智能体，同时支持递归式自我改进的扩展性（Schmidhuber, 2007；Zelikman et al., 2022；Madaan et al., 2023；Shinn et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate LEASH on OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) with four open-weight weak agents and Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) as the strong agent. At matched escalation rates, LEASH outperforms random escalation by 6.55–11.94 points. We further measure how much of the performance gap between the weak agent alone and always-on Opus is recovered by escalation, following the performance-gap metric of ( Burns et al., 2023 ) . LEASH recovers 75–102% of this gap, against 37–69% for random escalation, while costing 69–81% as much as always-on Opus. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , LEASH matches always-on Opus (73.7% vs. 72.9% success) at 19% lower cost, whereas random escalation at equal cost scores about 9 points lower (Figure 1 ).

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We formalize weak-to-strong escalation as a budget-constrained sequential stopping problem and show that one latent uncertainty signal can drive both escalation and oversight.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将弱到强的升级过程形式化为一个具有预算约束的序列停止问题，并证明一个潜在的未知不确定性信号即可同时引发升级和监管缺失。

paragraphs.en: We propose a training-free, scalable uncertainty scoring method that measures how much closer a hidden state lies to the weak agent’s own past failures than to its past successes, and provide theoretical justification for using this score for escalation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种无需训练、可扩展的不确定性评分方法，该方法衡量隐藏状态与弱智能体自身过往失败状态的接近程度，相较于其与过往成功状态的接近程度，并为使用此评分进行升级决策提供了理论依据。

paragraphs.en: We extend this uncertainty signal to weak-to-strong oversight, in which the white-box weak agent monitors the black-box strong agent through its own hidden states.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这种不确定性信号扩展到弱-强监督机制，其中白盒弱智能体通过其自身的隐藏状态来监控黑盒强智能体。

paragraphs.en: On OSWorld with four open-weight backbones, we show that LEASH outperforms random escalation at matched escalation rates and recovers 75–102% of the escalation gap at 69–81% of the cost of using always strong agent.
paragraphs.zh: 在采用四种开放权重主干网络的 OSWorld 中，我们证明了 LEASH 在与随机升级策略匹配的升级速率下表现更优，并且能以始终使用强智能体策略所需成本的 69%–81%，弥补 75%–102% 的升级差距。

paragraphs.en: Model routing and cascading offer a promising way to balance inference cost and performance, as demonstrated by FrugalGPT and RouteLLM ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Ong et al., 2025 ; Dekoninck et al., 2025 ) . Extending this idea to GUI automation, Adaptive VLM Routing selects models based on action difficulty and confidence ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , while StepWise trains lightweight monitors to detect execution stalls and identify milestones for escalation ( Wei et al., 2026 ) . Our work instead leverages the backbone agent’s internal representations to guide both task-level routing and step-level escalation, without training a dedicated monitoring network.
paragraphs.zh: 模型路由和级联方法为平衡推理成本与性能提供了一种有前景的途径，FrugalGPT 和 RouteLLM 的研究已证明了这一点（Chen 等人，2023；Ong 等人，2025；Dekoninck 等人，2025）。 将这一思路扩展到 GUI 自动化领域，Adaptive VLM Routing 会根据操作难度和置信度来选择模型（Liu 等人，2026），而 StepWise 则通过训练轻量级监控器来检测执行停滞，并识别需要升级操作的里程碑（Wei 等人，2026）。 与此不同，我们的研究利用主干智能体的内部表示来指导任务级路由和步骤级升级，而无需训练专门的监控网络。

paragraphs.en: Weak-to-strong generalization studies how stronger models learn from weaker supervision ( Burns et al., 2023 ; Somerstep et al., 2025 ; Medvedev et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2025 ; Jung et al., 2025 ) . These works primarily concern training-time transfer of supervision or capabilities from a weaker model to a stronger one. Here we study the complementary inference-time setting of weak-to-strong escalation (W2SE), where a weak model executes by default and selectively invokes a stronger model when additional capability is needed. This shifts the weak–strong relationship from supervision transfer to sequential resource allocation. We derive escalation signals from the agent’s own past experience without training an additional monitor.

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty estimation of agentic systems has emerged as one of the most important problems to monitor and guide agent decisions ( Oh et al., 2026b ; Chun et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2024 ) , while SafeGround and Argus investigate uncertainty estimation for GUI grounding, including calibrated predictions and representation-based methods ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Kumar et al., 2026 ) . Sampling-based uncertainty estimation and risk control have also been studied for question answering ( Duan et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , but repeated generation can be costly when applied at every step of a long-horizon agent trajectory. Meanwhile, another line of work explores weak-to-strong oversight of agent misbehavior and failure monitoring through observable trajectories ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ; Kale et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . Rather than focusing on either escalation or oversight alone, we handle both problem in a single unified fueled by a simple uncertainty estimate. That is, we integrate representation-based uncertainty estimation into the execution workflow, reusing the backbone model’s hidden states for escalation and extending the same signal to post-handoff oversight of a closed-source strong agent.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体系统的不确定性估计已成为监控和指导智能体决策的最重要问题之一（Oh 等，2026b；Chun 等，2026；Han 等，2024），而 SafeGround 和 Argus 则研究了 GUI 基础的不确定性估计，包括校准预测和基于表示的方法（Wang 等，2026；Kumar 等，2026）。 基于采样的不确定性估计和风险控制也已在问答任务中得到研究（Duan 等，2025；Wang 等，2025），但在长时程智能体轨迹的每一步都应用重复生成可能会产生高昂成本。 与此同时，另一条研究路线通过可观测轨迹探索对智能体不当行为和故障的弱到强监控（Greenblatt 等，2024；Kale 等，2026；Pan 等，2026）。 我们并未单独聚焦于升级或监控中的某一方面，而是通过一个简单的不确定性估计，将这两个问题整合到一个统一的框架中处理。 也就是说，我们将基于表示的不确定性估计整合到执行工作流中，复用骨干模型的隐藏状态以实现升级，并将相同的信号扩展到对闭源强智能体的移交后监控。

paragraphs.en: We introduce LEASH , a training-free uncertainty-driven agentic inference framework for W2SE and post-handoff oversight (Figure 2 ). By comparing the weak model’s runtime hidden states with successful and failed reference executions, we estimate uncertainty at task initialization and during execution, which guides both escalation to the strong agent and continued oversight after handoff. We first formulate the problem in Section 3.1 and introduce each component in subsequent sections.

paragraphs.en: Given a task query, a computer-use agent generates an action conditioned on the query, the screen, and history. We consider a lightweight, weak agent, e.g., a relatively small open-weight model with accessible hidden states, and a large, strong agent, e.g., a proprietary black-box frontier model, sharing a budget of T T actions. In addition to these two actor agents, we also host a Manager agent (with a strong model) who fires at the beginning to decompose the task and subsequently at subgoal boundaries to verify progress, constructing a minimal version of multi-agent workflow ( Agashe et al., 2025a ; Agashe et al., 2025b ; Koh et al., 2026 ) . Throughout execution, the Manager decomposes the task query into subgoals with screenshot-verifiable completion criteria and decides whether to advance, keep, or revise each subgoal (Appendix C ). This decomposition naturally provides finer-grained supervision ( Chun and Russakovsky, 2026 ) , allowing execution steps to inherit subgoal-level outcomes rather than relying solely on the final task-level label.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个任务查询，计算机使用智能体会根据该查询、屏幕和历史记录生成一个动作。 我们考虑一个轻量级的弱智能体（例如，一个相对较小的开放权重模型，其隐藏状态可被访问）和一个大型强智能体（例如，一个专有黑箱前沿模型），两者共享 T 个动作的预算。 除了这两个执行智能体之外，我们还部署了一个管理器智能体（使用一个强模型），它在开始时启动以分解任务，随后在子目标边界处验证进展，从而构建一个最小化的多智能体工作流程版本（Agashe et al., 2025a; Agashe et al., 2025b; Koh et al., 2026）。 在整个执行过程中，管理器将任务查询分解为具有可通过屏幕截图验证的完成标准的子目标，并决定是推进、保留还是修订每个子目标（附录 C）。 这种分解自然地提供了更精细的监督（Chun and Russakovsky, 2026），使得执行步骤可以继承子目标级别的成果，而不仅仅是依赖最终的任务级别标签。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by well-established observations revealing that LLMs internalize the likelihood of task success or failure in their representations ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Azaria and Mitchell, 2023 ; Kossen et al., 2024 ; Orgad et al., 2025 ) even before generating any tokens ( Ji et al., 2024 ; Cencerrado et al., 2025 ; Afzal et al., 2025 ) , we propose a training-free, representation-distance-based uncertainty estimation technique for agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: 基于已有研究证实，大型语言模型（LLM）在生成任何词元之前，其表示中已内化了任务成功或失败的可能性（Kadavath 等，2022；Azaria 和 Mitchell，2023；Kossen 等，2024；Orgad 等，2025），甚至更早阶段即已如此（Ji 等，2024；Cencerrado 等，2025；Afzal 等，2025），我们提出了一种无需训练、基于表示距离的智能体系统不确定性估计方法。

paragraphs.en: With the measure of uncertainty, we define escalation gates for each uncertainty channel. Two channels address different sources of uncertainty: ambiguity in task specification and failure likelihood across stacked interactions ( Oh et al., 2026b ) . The initial query-level routing can identify tasks beyond the weak agent’s capability in advance, but cannot anticipate every difficulty encountered during runtime execution. Therefore, we combine an initial escalation gate, g 0 = 𝕀 { u q ( h 0 ) > τ q } g_{0}=\mathbb{I}\bigl\{u_{q}(h_{0})>\tau_{q}\bigr\} which routes when g 0 = 1 g_{0}=1 , with a runtime escalation gate, g t = 𝕀 { u a ( h t ) > τ a } g_{t}=\mathbb{I}\bigl\{u_{a}(h_{t})>\tau_{a}\bigr\} for t ≥ 1 t\geq 1 that monitors each action of tasks retained by the initial gate given calibrated thresholds τ q \tau_{q} and τ a \tau_{a} . Runtime escalation occurs immediately after the first action with g t = 1 g_{t}=1 ; The strong agent then receives the instruction, current screenshot, and recent steps run by the weak agent, and keeps control until the task termination (See Appendix C for details).

paragraphs.en: LEASH consistently improves task success over standalone weak-agent execution across all four backbones (Table 1 ). At closely matched escalation rates, it also outperforms random task escalation by 6.55–11.94 percentage points, showing that the training-free uncertainty signal provides useful information for selective weak-to-strong escalation rather than merely increasing access to the strong executor. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) as the backbone, LEASH achieves 73.66% task success while escalating 64.1% of tasks, compared with 72.90% for always-on Opus ( Anthropic, 2026b ) . Besides, its estimated inference cost is $0.4117 per task, 19.2% lower than the $0.5094 cost of always-on Opus. The benefit also persists at lower escalation rates: LEASH improves Nemotron-3 ( Deshmukh et al., 2026 ) from 45.04% to 66.03% success while escalating 43.1% of tasks, and EvoCUA-8B ( Xue et al., 2026 ) from 42.37% to 67.18% while escalating 45.4%. paragraphs.en: We compare output probability-based uncertainty estimates with three representation-based alternatives: Euclidean distance to class centroids, kNN over reference representations, and our pooled LDA using covariance-aware Mahalanobis distance. The probability-based baseline considers several uncertainty metrics, including negative log-probability, chosen-token probability, predictive entropy, and nucleus-set size under different aggregation schemes ( Gupta et al., 2024 ) , and reports the strongest one in each setting. As shown in Table 3 , the effectiveness of each uncertainty estimator (i.e., how well it predicts task or sub-goal failure) varies across both backbones and execution stages. At the initial query-based uncertainty estimation stage, pooled LDA performs best for Nemotron, whereas probability-based baseline is stronger for Qwen3.8-27B. At the runtime step-wise estimation stage, our pooled LDA score achieves the highest AUROC for both backbones, although the overall effectiveness remains moderate. Overall, these results suggest that representation-based uncertainty can provide a training-free signal for runtime monitoring, particularly highlighting the effectiveness of our LDA-based estimation, while its effectiveness remains dependent on the backbone and execution stage. Meanwhile, the uncertainty estimator is modular in LEASH , allowing alternative, better uncertainty signals to be substituted without changing the escalation workflow depending on available resources or data ( Park et al., 2026b ; Park et al., 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: We introduced weak to strong escalation as a general inference paradigm for adaptive agent systems, in which inexpensive weak models handle routine execution and stronger models are invoked selectively when additional capability is needed. Under this paradigm, we proposed LEASH , a training-free, uncertainty-aware framework that supports initial routing, runtime escalation, and continued post-handoff oversight. Our results suggest that a shared latent uncertainty signal can support both selective escalation and post-handoff oversight, providing a practical mechanism for dynamically allocating model capability while retaining continued control over strong-agent execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种从弱到强的升级机制，作为自适应智能体系统的一种通用推理范式：其中成本较低的弱模型负责常规执行，而当需要额外能力时，则选择性地调用更强的模型。 在此范式下，我们提出了 LEASH——一个无需训练且能感知不确定性的框架，支持初始路由、运行时升级以及移交后的持续监督。 我们的研究结果表明，共享的潜在不确定性信号可以同时支持选择性升级和移交后的持续监督，从而为动态分配模型能力提供了一种实用机制，同时保持对强智能体执行过程的持续控制。

paragraphs.en: Our current evaluation is limited to computer-use agents on OSWorld, so the generality of weak-to-strong escalation beyond this domain remains to be validated. In addition, our uncertainty score estimates weak-agent failure risk rather than the expected benefit of escalation; Proposition 1 requires a condition that the escalation gain be nondecreasing in the score, which may fail when both weak and strong agents struggle on the same task. Finally, post-handoff Shadow monitoring operates under a distribution shift from weak-agent trajectories, and its intervention effect is not causally isolated in our current evaluation.

paragraphs.en: For each backbone, we construct a small held-out set of Manager-guided trajectories collected with escalation disabled and disjoint from the evaluation tasks. From this set, we construct the query and action representation banks: initial representations are labeled by task-level outcomes, while runtime representations inherit the outcomes of their corresponding subgoal segments.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个主干模型，我们构建一个小型的预留集，其中包含在禁用升级机制下收集到的、由管理器引导的轨迹，且这些轨迹与评估任务相互独立。 基于该集合，我们构建查询和动作表示库：初始表示通过任务层级的结果进行标注，而运行时表示则继承其对应子目标段的结果。

paragraphs.en: We use the same held-out reference set for both representation-bank construction and threshold calibration. Specifically, we perform task-grouped 10-fold cross-validation, keeping all steps from the same task in one fold. For each fold, an uncertainty estimator is fitted on the other nine folds and used only to score the held-out fold, yielding one out-of-fold score for every reference task. The fold-specific estimators are used only for calibration and are discarded afterwards.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在构建表示库和校准阈值时，都使用相同的预留参考集。 具体来说，我们按任务组进行 10 折交叉验证，并将同一任务的所有步骤保留在同一个折中。 对于每一折，不确定性估计器会在其余九折上进行拟合，并仅用于对预留折进行评分，从而为每个参考任务生成一个折外分数。 各折特定的估计器仅用于校准，之后即被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Shadow probes run at the first strong-agent step after handoff and at every third step thereafter. At every strong-agent step, including steps without a probe, the executed action is appended to the weak model’s history in that model’s own action format, so that each probe conditions on the actual trajectory rather than on the pre-handoff context. A probe calls the weak agent’s own action-generation routine, with its usual system prompt, tool schema, and image history, and does not invoke the Manager. The candidate action is logged for analysis but never executed or shown to the strong agent.
paragraphs.zh: 在交接后的第一个强智能体步骤以及此后的每第三个步骤中，都会运行影子探针。 在每个强智能体步骤中（包括没有探针的步骤），执行的动作都会以该弱模型自身的动作格式追加到其历史中，这样每个探针都能基于实际轨迹而非交接前的上下文进行条件判断。 探针会调用弱智能体自身的动作生成程序，使用其常规的系统提示、工具方案和图像历史，并且不会调用管理器。 候选动作会被记录用于分析，但绝不会执行或展示给强智能体。

paragraphs.en: At most six checkpoints can fire in an episode. paragraphs.en: When a checkpoint fires, the strong agent’s conversation is truncated to its length at the start of the current step, which removes the pending action; the neutral checkpoint message in Figure 7 is appended; and the strong agent re-decides the step with a raised reasoning-effort setting. The weak model’s candidate action is deliberately excluded from the checkpoint message, so the strong agent is never steered toward a specific action proposed by the weaker model.
paragraphs.zh: 当检查点触发时，强智能体的对话会被截断至当前步骤开始时的长度，从而移除待执行动作；图 7 中的中性检查点消息会被追加进去；然后，强智能体将以更高的推理努力设置重新决定该步骤。 弱模型候选动作会被刻意排除在检查点消息之外，因此强智能体绝不会因弱模型提出的特定动作而受到引导。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on OSWorld with screenshot observations and a shared budget of 50 actions per task. The lightweight backbones are EvoCUA-8B ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3.5-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni (30B-A3B) ( Deshmukh et al., 2026 ) , and Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) . Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) serves as both the Manager and strong executor, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 ( Anthropic, 2025 ) is an additional always-on reference. The always-on references run the strong model alone, without the Manager, so they measure strong-model capability without the Manager or escalation framework.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 OSWorld 上进行评估，使用屏幕截图作为观察信息，并为每个任务分配 50 次操作的共享预算。 轻量级骨干模型包括 EvoCUA-8B（Xue 等人，2026）、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（Qwen 团队，2026a）、Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni（30B-A3B）（Deshmukh 等人，2026）以及 Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen 团队，2026b）。 Claude Opus 5（Anthropic，2026b）同时担任管理者和强大执行者，而 Claude Sonnet 4.5（Anthropic，2025）则作为始终在线的额外参考模型。 始终在线的参考模型仅运行强大模型本身，而不包含管理者，因此它们衡量的是不包含管理者或升级框架的强大模型能力。

paragraphs.en: We use a held-out reference set that is disjoint from the 262 evaluation tasks. We obtain task-grouped 10-fold out-of-fold scores, keeping all observations from a task in one fold; preprocessing and estimator fitting use only the training folds. Initial scores use final task outcomes and runtime scores use Manager-assigned subgoal outcomes. Thresholds are order statistics of the held-out scores targeting a 25% initial and 50% overall escalation frequency, with runtime calibration based on per-task maximum scores. Refitting slightly changes the score scale, and differences between the reference and evaluation sets can further affect the realized escalation rate; hence the observed rates (43–64%) need not exactly match the calibration targets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个与 262 个评估任务互斥的预留参考集。 我们获得按任务分组的 10 折交叉验证得分，其中每个任务的所有观测值都保留在同一个折中；预处理和估计器拟合仅使用训练折。 初始得分使用最终的任务结果，而运行时得分则使用管理器分配的子目标结果。 阈值是预留得分的有序统计量，旨在实现 25% 的初始升级频率和 50% 的整体升级频率，其中运行时校准基于每个任务的最大得分。 重新拟合会轻微改变得分尺度，而参考集与评估集之间的差异可能进一步影响实际实现的升级率；因此，观测到的比率（43–64%）不必与校准目标完全一致。

paragraphs.en: After handoff, Shadow probes query the lightweight model every three strong-agent steps. Probe actions are not executed; their hidden representations provide the monitoring scores. Higher scores indicate greater uncertainty and can trigger an intervention that asks the strong agent to reassess its current strategy while retaining control.

paragraphs.en: We estimate inference cost from recorded token usage using OpenRouter reference prices, accounting for cached tokens where applicable. paragraphs.en: We compare pooled LDA with Euclidean distance, kNN, and probability-based baselines. The probability-based baseline considers negative log-probability, chosen-token probability, predictive entropy, and nucleus-set size under several aggregation schemes; we report the strongest statistic in each setting. Performance varies across backbones and execution stages, with pooled LDA providing the strongest overall discrimination in most settings. Runtime AUROC reflects discrimination of Manager-assigned subgoal-segment outcomes rather than individual action correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将池化 LDA 与欧氏距离、kNN 和基于概率的基线方法进行了比较。 基于概率的基线方法在多种聚合方案下考虑了负对数概率、所选 token 的概率、预测熵以及核集合的大小；我们在每种设置中报告了最强的统计指标。 性能因基础模型和执行阶段而异，其中池化 LDA 在大多数设置中提供了最强的整体区分能力。 运行时 AUROC 反映的是管理器分配的子目标分段结果的区分能力，而非单个动作的正确性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 – 10 present three representative examples of runtime escalation. Across all three cases, the weak agent remains on an unproductive GUI-based trajectory before the runtime gate triggers handoff. After takeover, the strong agent changes the execution strategy rather than simply continuing the weak agent’s actions ( Song et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 图 8–10 展示了运行时升级的三个代表性示例。 在所有三种情况下，弱智能体在运行时门触发交接之前，始终处于无成效的基于 GUI 的路径上。 接管后，强智能体改变了执行策略，而不仅仅是继续弱智能体的操作（Song 等人，2026）。

sents.en: Figure 8 – 10 present three representative examples of runtime escalation.
sents.zh: 图 8–10 展示了运行时升级的三个代表性示例。

sents.en: Across all three cases, the weak agent remains on an unproductive GUI-based trajectory before the runtime gate triggers handoff.
sents.zh: 在所有三种情况下，弱智能体在运行时门触发交接之前，始终处于无成效的基于 GUI 的路径上。

sents.en: After takeover, the strong agent changes the execution strategy rather than simply continuing the weak agent’s actions ( Song et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 接管后，强智能体改变了执行策略，而不仅仅是继续弱智能体的操作（Song 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: In the first case, the weak agent repeatedly interacts with an unresponsive macro interface while attempting to standardize text-box fonts. LEASH hands off at step 11, after which the strong agent switches from the macro GUI to a terminal-based python-pptx solution and completes the task in 27 actions; the Manager-only run instead exhausts the 50-action budget.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一种情况下，弱智能体在试图标准化文本框字体的同时，反复与一个无响应的宏界面进行交互。 LEASH 在第 11 步移交任务，此后强智能体从宏 GUI 切换到基于终端的 python-pptx 解决方案，并在 27 次操作中完成任务；而仅使用管理者的运行方式则耗尽了 50 次操作的预算。

sents.en: In the first case, the weak agent repeatedly interacts with an unresponsive macro interface while attempting to standardize text-box fonts.
sents.zh: 在第一种情况下，弱智能体在试图标准化文本框字体的同时，反复与一个无响应的宏界面进行交互。

sents.en: LEASH hands off at step 11, after which the strong agent switches from the macro GUI to a terminal-based python-pptx solution and completes the task in 27 actions; the Manager-only run instead exhausts the 50-action budget.
sents.zh: LEASH 在第 11 步移交任务，此后强智能体从宏 GUI 切换到基于终端的 python-pptx 解决方案，并在 27 次操作中完成任务；而仅使用管理者的运行方式则耗尽了 50 次操作的预算。

paragraphs.en: In the second case, the weak agent repeatedly opens, inspects, and closes candidate photos. Handoff occurs at step 8, and the strong agent replaces this loop with keyboard navigation and multi-selection, successfully creating the requested archive in 27 actions. The corresponding Manager-only run creates an incorrect archive and receives a score of zero.
paragraphs.zh: 在第二种情况下，弱智能体反复打开、查看并关闭候选照片。 在第 8 步发生交接，强智能体用键盘导航和多选功能取代了这一循环，成功在 27 次操作中创建了所需的存档。 相应的仅由管理器运行的版本创建了一个错误的存档，并获得了零分。

sents.en: In the second case, the weak agent repeatedly opens, inspects, and closes candidate photos.
sents.zh: 在第二种情况下，弱智能体反复打开、查看并关闭候选照片。

sents.en: Handoff occurs at step 8, and the strong agent replaces this loop with keyboard navigation and multi-selection, successfully creating the requested archive in 27 actions.
sents.zh: 在第 8 步发生交接，强智能体用键盘导航和多选功能取代了这一循环，成功在 27 次操作中创建了所需的存档。

sents.en: The corresponding Manager-only run creates an incorrect archive and receives a score of zero.
sents.zh: 相应的仅由管理器运行的版本创建了一个错误的存档，并获得了零分。

paragraphs.en: In the third case, the weak agent spends 23 steps browsing and searching without installing the requested LibreOffice extension. After handoff at step 24, the strong agent switches to a terminal-based installation strategy and successfully installs LanguageTool, whereas the Manager-only run exhausts the action budget without completing the installation.
paragraphs.zh: 在第三种情况下，弱智能体花费了 23 个步骤进行浏览和搜索，但并未安装所请求的 LibreOffice 扩展。 在第 24 步完成交接后，强智能体转而采用基于终端的安装策略并成功安装了 LanguageTool，而仅运行管理者的流程则因耗尽操作预算而未完成安装。

sents.en: After handoff at step 24, the strong agent switches to a terminal-based installation strategy and successfully installs LanguageTool, whereas the Manager-only run exhausts the action budget without completing the installation.
sents.zh: 在第 24 步完成交接后，强智能体转而采用基于终端的安装策略并成功安装了 LanguageTool，而仅运行管理者的流程则因耗尽操作预算而未完成安装。

paragraphs.en: Together, these examples illustrate that runtime escalation can identify stalled or inefficient execution trajectories and enable a strong agent to adopt qualitatively different strategies rather than merely continuing the weak agent’s current path.
paragraphs.zh: 这些例子共同说明，运行时升级能够识别停滞或低效的执行轨迹，并使强大的智能体采用性质截然不同的策略，而不仅仅是继续弱智能体的当前路径。
